equations.assumptions: Independent family observations with Xi in [-1,1]; target is expected equal-family-weight average; alpha in (0,1), n>=1. No within-family independence required.
equations.author_derivation: Tilted distributions remain on an interval of length two, so variance<=1, giving log centered MGF<=t^2/2. Product of moments uses independence. Markov gives exp(-ntr+nt^2/2), minimized at t=r. Two tails then union over six contrasts gives 12 exp(-n r^2/2).
symbolic_checks: Substituted radius makes six-comparison bound exactly alpha
equations.one_family_interval: Full [-1,1] for any observed difference in [-1,1]
